usedFor: ResourceGuru holds bookings, projects and clients, and Google Docs receives their details through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Updated Booking” in ResourceGuru, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Every booking change can refresh a document tab, so the schedule text stays current.

watchOut: “New or Updated Booking” covers creation, update and deletion, so the same booking can write to the document twice.
